baseline.name: Materialize all prefix altitudes
baseline.approach: Store the starting altitude and every cumulative altitude, then find the maximum.

why: Only the current altitude and largest altitude are needed when returning one maximum.
quantitative_comparison: The archive replaces n+1 stored altitudes with two integers and combines accumulation/maximum checks in one pass. Time growth stays linear; no elapsed speedup is claimed.
tradeoffs: Does not retain the route for later queries, and cumulative altitude must fit int. The benefit is storage relative to a materialized-route baseline.
evidence_basis: Static live-state analysis versus prefix materialization; no benchmark.
